steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Vikunja at http://127.0.0.1:8096/ with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type it exactly like that, it gets filled in). Then open the project 'Bench Project' and list the titles of the tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:' exactly as shown. Report those titles.

02-create: In the project 'Bench Project', create a new task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' with description containing '{{runid}}', due date 2026-12-31, priority High, and assign the EXISTING label 'Backend' (pick it from suggestions; do not create a new one). Then add a comment on that task whose text contains '{{runid}}'. Verify the task page shows due date 2026-12-31, priority High, label Backend, the comment, and report the task's displayed identifier like 'BENCH-<number>'.

03-open: Open the task '{{runid}} Bench Task' ({{02-create.task_identifier}}) in project 'Bench Project' and verify, reading from the task page: (a) the title, (b) the description contains '{{runid}}', (c) the due date shows 2026-12-31, (d) the priority is High, (e) the label 'Backend' is attached (exactly one, not a duplicate), (f) a comment containing '{{runid}}' exists, (g) the displayed identifier. Report each value exactly as shown on the page. Do not change anything.
